inputBoundary: One already-derived nonnegative integer count of distinct users who accepted the study terms of service per country.
outputBoundary: Include a country only when its supplied accepted-user count is at least 20,000; equality is included.
limitations: This binding does not determine whether a user accepted the study terms of service.
This binding does not identify or deduplicate users or attribute them to countries.
This binding does not group records or derive country-level accepted-user counts.
A missing country count fails closed rather than being interpreted as zero.
The 20,000-person public sample is not used as evidence for any country's eligibility count.
